name: Gravy Analytics
sells: location data tied to MAIDs and IP addresses
mobile device location data (lat/long tied to advertising IDs) and foot-traffic data
data received from mobile app owners and data aggregators who collect it through SDKs (none named)
identity linking of MAIDs to hashed emails and IPs (Unacast 'Data Linkages')

optOut.notes: 'Opt Out & Do Not Sell' page; privacy contact privacy@gravyanalytics.com, 703-840-8850. Unacast's own policy names the entity as 'Gravy Analytics, Inc. dba Unacast', with its opt-out at unacast.com/opt-out. gravyanalytics.com now serves Unacast's site. The older gravyanalytics.com/opt-out page is a stale 2019 page.
